content.title: Reading-Triggered Transformation | Page Light, Form Handoff, Action Continuity
content.summary: An origami fox becomes an adult cartographer while continuing one journal reading action. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One book and reading action precede transformation. + Energy emerges from the visible page surface. + Body change preserves gaze, pose and object contact. + The adult final identity stabilizes before the endpoint. + Reading resumes to prove continuity rather than replacement.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one small origami fox reading an open brass-bound field journal inside an original night archive. Extend the silhouette into one clearly adult fox-eared cartographer seated in the same position. The adult cartographer turns one page and holds as the diagram becomes a bounded map above the book.
required_anchors: One book and reading action precede transformation.
Energy emerges from the visible page surface.
The adult final identity stabilizes before the endpoint.
Reading resumes to prove continuity rather than replacement.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: An origami fox becomes an adult cartographer while continuing one journal reading action. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.
